fit_reason: Whole SUV listed by a private owner in cars by owner.
findings: Yellowed, hazy headlight lenses on both front headlights
Faded gray unpainted plastic on the front and rear bumper lower trim
Paint on hood and doors looks a bit flat rather than deep gloss in the low sun
Light dust and lint on the driver floor area and rubber floor mat
Cloth front seats look clean but slightly dull, could use a light refresh
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the RAV4 and it looks well kept. The headlights have some yellowing and the bumper trim is a little faded, which buyers tend to notice in photos. We do pre-sale details including headlight and trim restoration and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
